//: Type-checking config for the scripts/ tree — the 18 suites plus the live verifiers.
A SECOND config rather than a widening of tsconfig.json: the build config has
`rootDir: ./src` and emits to dist/, so including scripts/**/* there would ship the
test corpus in the build output.
`rootDir` widens to the project root because scripts/ sits beside src/; `noEmit`
because nothing here is built. src/**/* stays included so the `declare global` blocks
that add req.admin and req.requestId are in scope — the same reason the ts-node `files`
flag exists in tsconfig.json, and the same failure it was added to fix.
Run via `npm run typecheck:scripts`. See PRODUCTION-READINESS plan step 0.C.
